explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/689: for large n, is there a choice of classes a_p for the primes p ≤ n such that every integer in [1,n] satisfies at least two of the congruences ≡ a_p (mod p)? The statement asks, for all large n, for a : ℕ → ℕ such that each m ∈ [1,n] has ≥ 2 primes p ≤ n with a p ≡ m (mod p). Faithful. The 'solved' status rests on the cited Chojecki preprint and the linked Lean proof; the erdosproblems page text does not yet record a resolution (only a proof claim).
